title: Nourishing Light Korean Red Cabbage Noodles
description: A savory and light Korean dish featuring red cabbage, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and is dairy-free friendly. This dish is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and add the grated ginger and minced garlic.
Cook the ginger and garlic for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Add the shredded red cabbage to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it starts to soften.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the red cabbage and stir to combine.
Season the red cabbage mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Drain the cooked noodles and add them to the skillet with the red cabbage mixture.
Stir everything together and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
